verdict.rationale:
Temporal provides official SDKs across multiple languages (Python, TypeScript, etc.) plus explicit AI-oriented integrations (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK, AWS AgentCore Runtime) and a dedicated AI solutions page framing orchestration of models/agents via Durable Execution. This directly supports building AI-native applications against official SDKs rather than third-party wrappers.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration specifically validating the AI SDK integrations (ADK, Vercel AI SDK, AgentCore), and broader language coverage details beyond Python/TypeScript.
